subject.title: fix: Slack drops attachments delivered via message_changed file_share events

question: If the redacted trace shows an initial OpenClaw dispatch before file finalization, should one Slack post produce one finalized agent turn or separate partial and finalized turns?
rationale: Source and tests establish per-content-version delivery, but the intended user-visible dispatch count requires maintainer judgment after live evidence.

options.title: One finalized turn
options.body: Delay or coalesce an incomplete initial upload so the agent receives the completed file set once.

options.title: Per-version turns
options.body: Allow the partial and finalized versions to dispatch separately and document that behavior as intentional.

recommendation.title: One finalized turn
recommendation.body: Delay or coalesce an incomplete initial upload so the agent receives the completed file set once.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current semantics, are the active assignee, and own the trace-capture effort.
